events.command: ls -la && echo "--- build ---" && find build -type f -o -type d | head -50
for f in junk.log notes.tmp build/out.o build/cache/tmp.bin; do echo "=== $f ($(wc -c <"$f") bytes) ==="; head -c 400 "$f"; echo; done
rm -f junk.log notes.tmp && rm -rf build && git status --porcelain -uall; echo "exit: $?"; ls -la
